title: Doomsday
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Doomsday,' the office characters engage in various activities including singing, testing a new accountability device, and dealing with a potential email crisis. Dwight introduces a device he claims is an 'accountability booster,' which Jim humorously compares to a doomsday device. The episode features office interactions, conflicts over the email, and humorous remarks about the doomsday device and office relationships.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's accountability booster and office conflicts

evidence.snippet: Dwight: The accountability booster. It registers every time a mistake has been made in the office.
Jim: Wait, so you installed a doomsday device?
Dwight: No, it's an accountability booster.
Jim: Which when it goes off it destroys everything. Very similar to a doomsday device.
Oscar: There's an easy way to tell if this device is a sham. We just make a mistake.
Dwight: I haven't even considered it. That's how sure I am that this accountability booster is going to work.
